hook: Americans owe around $1.6 trillion on car loans, and the average new car payment is now around $750 a month. In this video I look at the car payment trap from three angles: the real numbers (depreciation, 7-year loans, negative equity, the $100,000 car payment), the dealer psychology, and a 10-move playbook to buy and own a car the smart way.
